title: Random-bit logarithmic scale
statement: Let $k,n$ be positive integers with $k\le n$, and let $a,b$ be positive integers with $2a\le b$. The random-bit logarithmic scale is the sum of $\lceil\log_2 k\rceil$, $\lceil\log_2(d+1)\rceil$, and $\lceil\log_2 s\rceil$, where $d=\max(1,\lceil\log_2 n\rceil)$ and $s$ is the reciprocal scale associated with the input.
caveat: The payload does not define the reciprocal scale, so the final term cannot be made fully self-contained.
